name: Gravity Creative Space
description: Tel Aviv creative, design, animation and visual effects group founded in 1994 as the post-production house Gravity VFX and Design. It built a North American arm (Rhino FX, later rebranded Gravity) that worked on Hollywood features and US commercials, while the Tel Aviv studio serves Israeli and international advertising.
notable_work: The Other Guys (VFX via Rhino/Gravity US)
The Dybbuk of the Holy Apple Field (1997, digital effects)
Bezeq — Bezeq Energy with Adi Ashkenazi (2025)
Carolina Lemke — winter campaign with Bar Refaeli & Yehuda Levi (2025)
yes — campaign with Noa Kirel & Daniel Peretz (2026)
